subject: Math
prompt: Which of the following ordered pairs $(x, y)$ satisfies the inequality $3x + 2y \le 18$?
explanation: Substituting $x = 4$ and $y = 3$ into the inequality $3x + 2y \leq 18$ gives $3(4) + 2(3) \leq 18$, which simplifies to $12 + 6 \leq 18$, or $18 \leq 18$. This is true, so the ordered pair $(4, 3)$ satisfies the inequality.
